name: 林榮禾
objective:
本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topics include: probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.
schedule:
W1	Data and Statistics (Ch 1)	
W2	Descriptive Statistics: Tabular and Graphical Displays (Ch 2)	
W3	Descriptive Statistics: Numerical Measures (Ch 3)	
W4	Data Distribution, Outliers and EDA (Ch 3)	(Quiz 1)
W5	Introduction to Probability: Experiments & Rules (Ch 4)	
W6	First Midterm Exam (Ch 1 - Ch 4 Fundamentals)	(Exam 1)
W7	Conditional Probability, Independence & Bayes' Theorem (Ch 4)	
W8	Discrete Probability Distributions: Expected Value (Ch 5)	
W9	Binomial, Poisson, and Hypergeometric Distributions (Ch 5)	(Quiz 2)
W10	Continuous Probability Distributions: Normal Distribution (Ch 6)	
W11	Exponential Distribution and Normal Approximation (Ch 6)	
W12	Second Midterm Exam (Ch 4 Advanced - Ch 6)	(Exam 2)
W13	Sampling and Sampling Distributions (Ch 7)	
W14	Central Limit Theorem (CLT) and Point Estimation (Ch 7)	
W15	Interval Estimation: Population Mean ($\sigma$ Known/Unknown) (Ch 8)	
W16	Population Proportion and Sample Size Determination (Ch 8)	 (Quiz 3)
W17	Sampling and Non-sampling Errors in the Big Data Era	
W18	Third Midterm Exam (Final Exam Ch 7 - Ch 8)	 (Exam 3)
scorePolicy:

延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG1：消除貧窮（No Poverty）SDG2：消除飢餓（Zero Hunger）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG5：性別平等（Gender Equality）
